summary: Greystone Housing Impact Investors LP filed an 8-K announcing the sale of Vantage at Loveland, a 288-unit multifamily property in Loveland, CO, on August 13, 2026, at the managing member's direction. The Partnership originally contributed $23.2 million in April 2021, with $2.1 million returned in March 2025 refinancing and $5.8 million preferred return received then. At sale closing, the Partnership received net cash of $23.6 million, redeeming its remaining $21.1 million equity and $2.5 million accrued preferred return. It expects $2.5 million investment income and $0.11 net income per BUC in Q3 2026. What to watch: final Q3 earnings impact and redeployment of proceeds.
